summary: Live validation found that the merged PostgreSQL digest is not a valid Docker Hub manifest, leaving the homelab MetaMCP PostgreSQL pod in ImagePullBackOff. The MetaMCP image and GitOps sync are otherwise healthy enough to expose the database pull failure.
validation: PR #439 merged at 994ebd8a686adb003535f6a4beecb963b03284ae and Argo metamcp synced that revision.
MetaMCP deployment is running 2.4.22 at its immutable digest.
PostgreSQL pod metamcp-postgresql-0 is ImagePullBackOff on the declared digest.
Kubernetes events report Docker Hub HEAD 400 for the declared bitnami/postgresql digest.
Docker manifest inspection verified the current amd64 latest manifest digest cf11d5856d9dddff104ec7b2b287fcf8ed040527dacabc69caed05a9255c7cac.
The live registry bootstrap was not run because PostgreSQL was unavailable.
blockers: Replace the invalid PostgreSQL digest through a new GitOps PR and wait for the homelab StatefulSet to become Ready.
After database recovery, rerun the protected registry bootstrap and all per-server/OAuth validation.
next_action: Return to code, update the PostgreSQL digest to the verified amd64 manifest, validate and merge the corrective PR, then resume validation.
independent_lanes: Docker manifest and immutable image correction
Post-recovery MCP registry and OAuth validation

issues.title: Declared PostgreSQL digest cannot be pulled
issues.details: The declared sha256:be00bd... reference returns Docker Hub 400; use the verified amd64 manifest digest before retrying the rollout.
